title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: balance floor for missed-payment recovery
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, a payment intended to bring the employer's master account current is likewise applied in full against whatever the enrollment currently shows owed. If that owed amount is negative, meaning the enrollment currently shows a credit rather than an amount owed, it is treated as zero for this purpose, so a credit balance is never further reduced by applying such a payment.

Worked example (hypothetical): if an enrollment currently showed a credit balance, applying a missed-payment recovery payment against it would still floor the amount available to apply at zero, rather than deepening that credit.
